verdict.rationale: Docs show a straightforward 'first email' onboarding via API/cURL and SMTP (sendgrid-docs-4/17/5) and a distinct sandbox mode for validation-only testing (sendgrid-docs-6/18), implying that outside sandbox, real emails can be sent early in the account lifecycle. However, no evidence explicitly describes a free-tier or trial plan's send limits, or confirms it permits genuine delivery to real end users rather than just testing; community reports of accounts being frozen or placed under review without notice (sendgrid-comm-9, sendgrid-comm-12) add caveats about trial/account reliability. Missing for 10: explicit free/trial plan terms, documented free-tier send quotas, and confirmation that real (non-sandbox) delivery to end users is unrestricted on that tier.
